captions.detailed: A tall, narrow candy vending machine featuring a matte black cabinet housing three levels of spiral candy dispensers visible behind a blue-tinted glass front panel. The center column displays a control panel with a prominent orange hexagonal selector dial, while the lower section includes a dark translucent retrieval flap and a silver-colored cash drawer at the very bottom. The cash drawer translates prismatically forward and backward on runners, the retrieval flap rotates on a horizontal hinge, and the orange selector dial rotates continuously about its central shaft.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a narrow candy vending machine tower. The model should feature a black main cabinet with a glass display window showing stacked candy spirals, a control panel with an orange rotating selector dial, a hinged retrieval flap, and a sliding cash drawer at the base. Ensure the cash drawer has prismatic motion, the flap has revolute motion, and the dial has continuous rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a tall, hollowed-out box primitive with a cut-out front for the glass window. Create the internal candy spirals and shelves using helical sweeps and thin plates, respectively. Model the control panel, retrieval flap, and cash drawer as separate rigid bodies using box and cylinder primitives, then define their relative articulation joints: a prismatic joint for the cash drawer along the depth axis, a revolute joint for the retrieval flap along its upper horizontal edge, and a continuous joint for the cylindrical selector dial.
